service.name: Morbol (Mount)
service.longDescription: Though all it has ever wanted is to help, this morbol was found to be “too sweet” to present a challenge at the Celestium, and was transferred to the Blue Mages’ Guild before it had even seen its first match─only for it to be deemed “insufficiently vile” there as well.

rewards.title: Guaranteed Mount Drop From
rewards.text: Completing the "Blue Unchained" and "Masked Conqueror" Achievements (Blue Mage).

rewards.title: Savage Loot
rewards.text: Savage specific loot from completing the Alexander and Bahamut fights as Blue Mage.

rewards.title: Blue Justice & Unbound Blue
rewards.text: Exclusive titles acquired from completing the Blue Mage fights.

rewards.title: Achievement: "True Blue"
rewards.text: Achievement unlocked upon obtaining the "Blue Unchained" and "Masked Conqueror" achievements.
